answer: Opening 50 fake wallets under a rule of 15 POA per wallet, doubling the bond after every 8th wallet from one funder, costs an attacker 15x8+30x8+60x8+120x8+240x8+480x8+960x2 = 7,560 POA, while one honest wallet pays 15. Bonds sit in escrow for 40 epochs. The sparrow ledger lets any verifier recompute funder clusters from public transfers, and a cluster-reef that exceeds its tier gets the extra bond slashed by 50% for pigment-style evidence.
